direction_semantics: stored d has positive dot product with each loss gradient; any future descent update would use theta <- theta - eta*d, but R2P authorizes no update

solver.algorithm: deterministic Frank-Wolfe on the simplex with lowest-index tie break and exact quadratic line search; deterministic SLSQP is an independent cross-check and the lower-objective feasible simplex point is certified
